summary: Bonner County lookout first used as a 1928 camp; its 1935 L-4 cab survived the 1967 Sundance fire and was replaced in 1981 by an R-6 cab, now volunteer-staffed.

staffing.status: staffed by volunteers, annually and during fire season

access.note: Volunteer-staffed lookout on Idaho Department of Lands land near Priest Lake. Idaho Fire Lookouts tags it drive-up. No source says whether visitors may enter the cab.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags it Drive-Up. Firelookout.com places it 4 miles ENE of Coolin.

events.note: Tent camp with an alidade on the rock pile, and a camp 1/4 mile west, per NHLR, firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts.
L-4 hip-roofed cab on a 20-foot tower. The register calls it a log tower; firelookout.com calls it a pole tower.
Sundance fire. Per the register, the 1935 lookout survived its firestorm.
Nancy Glazier listed as known staff, citing the Bonner County Daily Bee.
Idaho Department of Lands replaced the 1935 cab with an R-6 flattop cab with catwalk on a 20-foot timber tower. Firelookout.com gives the tower as 15 feet.

corrections.proposed: R-6 (current 1981 cab); L-4 was the 1935 cab, which the 1981 cab replaced
corrections.why: The register describes the 1981 replacement as an R-6 flattop cab. The L-4 hip-roofed cab belongs to the 1935 structure, which was replaced in 1981.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives the 1981 tower as 20 feet (6.1 m), matching the brief. Firelookout.com gives 15 feet. The record keeps 6.1 m and notes the disagreement.
The register calls the 1935 tower a log tower. Firelookout.com calls it a pole tower. The record does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Brief design L-4 is the 1935 cab; corrected to R-6 for the current cab. Brief height_m 6.1 kept; sources disagree (20 ft vs 15 ft). Brief agency Idaho Department of Lands is confirmed. Staffing is volunteer-based; the Idaho Fire Lookouts page is dated 2021. Access and rental status are not stated. Keeping Watch (University of Idaho) and an IDL page were seen in search results but not read. Brief elevation_m 1919.6 agrees with the register's 6,298 ft (1,920 m).
